title: Local deterministic M0-M2 contribution-control proof boundary

decision.summary: Freeze the selected live base and the additive integration boundary for a pure local contribution intake, scheduling, verification, merge-authorization and LKG-recovery simulation.

governingContext.interpretation: The governing decisions remain authoritative and are referenced, not restated, replaced or reinterpreted here.

selectedLiveBase.subject: docs: keep README quickstart bound to release truth (#293)
selectedLiveBase.baseSelectionRule: All status and integration decisions in this receipt come from direct reads of this exact tree. Issue text and predecessor plans are not treated as evidence of live-base status.

localToolingObservation.handling: Record as local infrastructure evidence; do not convert it into a product failure or a passing test claim. The controller must run authoritative npm gates on pinned Node/host infrastructure.

dedicatedM0M2Simulation.statement: The selected tree contains no dedicated local deterministic M0-M2 queue, slot, fairness, merge-authorization or recovery simulator.

existingIntakeLedger.publicClosureObservation: The source, schema and test are present in release/public-files.manifest and SHA256SUMS on the selected base.
existingIntakeLedger.releaseClaimObservation: No contribution-intake entry was found in release/governance.json or docs/capabilities.md; this receipt therefore makes no regular-release status claim for the ledger.
existingSemantics: A prevalidated trust context binds ledger, tenant, repository, contribution, actor, authority-evidence and authority-scope identities.
Exact transport redelivery returns TRANSPORT_DUPLICATE without appending a second ledger entry.
Delivery-ID reuse with changed canonical delivery bytes is quarantined as tamper.
The same current head is a SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE; replay of a superseded or invalidated head is STALE and quarantined.
A new descendant or force-pushed head supersedes the prior current head; only the current appended head is deep-CI eligible.
Scope substitution, authority widening and authority change are rejected and quarantined.
Entry sequence is one-based and contiguous, previousEntryDigest forms an append-only digest chain, and full verification semantically replays from genesis.

algorithm.objectOrder: Own enumerable string keys sorted by JavaScript Array.prototype.sort; arrays retain index order.
algorithm.scalarEncoding: JSON.stringify for null, booleans, finite numbers and strings.
algorithm.acceptedContainers: Arrays and ordinary plain objects only.
algorithm.bytes: UTF-8 bytes of canonicalJson(value), with no trailing newline.
algorithm.digest: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes, encoded as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
algorithm.domainSeparation: For contribution intake, hash canonicalJson({domain, value}); the domain is an exact immutable versioned string.
algorithm.trust: A digest is a content-integrity binding, not a signature, identity assertion or authority grant.

existingCanonicalContract.successorNumericRestriction: The M0-M2 additive contract must accept only closed JSON data and non-negative safe integers, must reject negative zero, floats, unsafe integers, sparse or exotic arrays, accessors, symbols, cycles, dangerous keys and non-plain prototypes before canonicalization.

existingVerificationFabric.v1Purpose: Closed verification plan, independent self-test identity, check runs, evidence bundle, verdict, revalidation trigger and LKG pointer/readback verification.
existingVerificationFabric.v2Purpose: Repository evidence-DAG validation, impact planning, fail-closed fallback, attestation verification and shadow-comparison interfaces.
existingVerificationFabric.compositionDecision: The successor simulator consumes these exports and emits compatible local-synthetic data. It must not fork their schema strings, reason codes, digest rules or independence checks. It must not invoke real checks or treat shadow mode as merge authority.

existingVersionAndLkgContracts.decision: Reuse the six-axis UpdateTupleV1/updateTupleDigestV1 and exact tuple-lock/LKG verification patterns as shared version-lock primitives. The contribution-control simulator adds its own closed merge-state tuple; it does not alter or relabel update/maintenance contracts and none of those contracts grants merge authority.

barrel.allowedFutureExtension: One additive export from ./contribution-control-plane-simulation.js after its implementation and tests exist.

verificationFabricV2.executionFence: runVerificationShadowComparatorV2 is an existing interface but is outside this simulator's execution boundary; the simulator records fixture outcomes as data and never launches checks or candidate code.

rules: Every axis is present and non-empty for a complete lock.
Each component has an axis-appropriate componentId, an exact immutable semantic version and a SHA-256 digest.
Component IDs are unique within an axis and are sorted by componentId before canonical projection.
Mutable aliases, latest, ranges, unresolved values, duplicate components and digest drift deny fail closed.
The authority profile digest is immutable across a checked transition.
Version-lock acceptance is not execution, merge, promotion or release authority.

existingAndExtendableByASeparateImplemen.extension: Add only the new simulator barrel export.
Add only a focused simulator test script if the implementation slice requires it.
Add only bounded simulator source/schema/test ownership and evidence edges while preserving existing hard gates.

notOwnedOrAuthorizedByThisReceipt: product code outside the separately listed successor paths
remotes, providers, services or external state
pathOwnership.rule: No path outside docs/evidence/conveyor/sol-psai52-state-reconcile-01.json may be changed by SOL-PSAI52-STATE-RECONCILE-01. Successor path entries describe an integration boundary, not authority for this worker to modify them.

profileEnvelope.sourceOrdinal: Each profile event wrapper carries a strict one-based contiguous sourceOrdinal. The inner ContributionDeliveryV1 remains unchanged and closed.
profileEnvelope.logicalTime: Each event carries fixture-supplied logicalAtMs in the closed wrapper; logicalAtMs is non-decreasing and within [0, logicalWindowMs).
profileEnvelope.generation: IDs, digests, event classes and fault positions are derived solely from the locked seed, profileId and sourceOrdinal. No wall clock or random source participates.

boundedOutputs.eventReceipts: At most one wrapper receipt per source event.
boundedOutputs.intakeLedgerEntries: At most eventCount; exact transport redeliveries do not append.
boundedOutputs.semanticEffects: At most eventCount and unique by semanticEffectId.
boundedOutputs.queueRecords: At most one live queue record per current semantic identity.
boundedOutputs.slotRecords: At most the finite slot count per scheduling tick.
boundedOutputs.mergeEffects: At most one authorized semantic merge effect per mergeTupleDigest.
boundedOutputs.summaries: Exactly one canonical terminal summary per scenario.

fixtureSafeContributorProjection.statusMeaning: Fixture statuses describe only simulated state; they do not state contributor trust, employment, entitlement, reputation, review approval or merge authority.

fixtureContract.fixtureDataFence: Fixtures are closed JSON data only. They contain no executable source, command, shell fragment, path traversal, URL, callback, package reference, credential, personal data or production payload.

determinismContract.canonicalSerialization: Use the existing canonicalJson export and the stricter successor numeric/data boundary recorded above.
determinismContract.canonicalBytes: UTF-8(canonicalJson(value)) with no BOM and no trailing newline.
determinismContract.domainRule: Every digestable type uses canonicalJson({domain, value}) where domain is an immutable exact versioned string; self-digest fields are excluded before wrapping.

clock.advanceRule: Advance only to explicit fixture times or by one scheduler tick; never read Date, Date.now, performance.now, process uptime or filesystem timestamps.
clock.orderingUse: Logical time measures queue age, evidence age and recovery only after sourceOrdinal has fixed causal order.

determinismContract.replayOracle: Two fresh replays of canonical-equivalent cloned inputs under the same version lock, clock and seed must produce byte-identical canonical terminal state, receipts, metrics and digests. Object insertion order must not alter bytes.
determinismContract.versionLock: The exact shared six-axis tuple digest, simulator contract version, canonicalizer source digest, verification DAG digest and fixture-manifest digest are inputs to every scenario digest. Mutable or missing inputs deny before M0.

eventIdentity.contentDigest: Digest of the complete normalized ContributionDeliveryV1 under cm.contribution-delivery/v1.
eventIdentity.exactRedelivery: The key and complete content digest match an earlier delivery. Return TRANSPORT_DUPLICATE and the prior intake sequence; append no entry and apply no semantic effect.
eventIdentity.keyReuseWithDifferentBytes: Quarantine as DELIVERY_ID_REUSE_TAMPER and apply no semantic effect.

semanticIdentity.semanticEffectId: SHA-256 domain-bound digest of the closed semantic-identity fields plus effectKind.
semanticIdentity.sameCurrentHead: A new transport event for the same semantic identity is SEMANTIC_DUPLICATE and applies no second semantic effect.
semanticIdentity.newHead: A distinct headDigest for the same contribution creates one HEAD_RECONCILED effect and supersedes exactly the prior current head.
semanticIdentity.exactlyOnceInvariant: All semanticEffectId values are unique; each admitted non-duplicate current-head transition has exactly one effect, and no denied, stale, transport-duplicate or semantic-duplicate event has an effect.

sequenceAndCausality.sourceOrder: sourceOrdinal is strict, contiguous, one-based and authoritative within a profile; missing, duplicate, regressing or gapped ordinals deny the complete profile.
sequenceAndCausality.intakeSequence: Preserve ContributionIntakeLedgerV1 one-based contiguous sequences and previousEntryDigest chaining. Exact redelivery reuses its prior sequence and does not advance nextSequence.
sequenceAndCausality.effectSequence: Each applied semantic effect receives the next one-based contiguous effectSequence; events with no effect do not advance it.
sequenceAndCausality.causalParent: For a normal supersession, ancestorDigest equals the current head and therefore references an earlier accepted semantic identity. Unknown, future or cyclic claimed ancestry denies unless the event is explicitly classified as a force push.
sequenceAndCausality.tieBreak: No wall-time sorting is allowed. Source order is sourceOrdinal; scheduler ties use enqueuedTick, semanticSequence, contributorId and candidateId in that exact order.
sequenceAndCausality.fullReplay: Verification reconstructs state from genesis and recomputes every event, entry, effect, queue, lease, verification, merge and terminal-state digest. A rehashed impossible history denies.

forcePushAndSupersession.forcePush: A context-bound distinct head with no accepted current ancestor is an explicit PR_HEAD_FORCE_PUSH transition, never an authority change by itself.
forcePushAndSupersession.supersession: The new head atomically becomes current and the previous current head becomes SUPERSEDED or INVALIDATED according to existing intake reason codes.
forcePushAndSupersession.phaseBarrier: Every bounded profile is fully reconciled in M0 before M1 queue materialization. M1 derives eligibility exclusively from deepCiEligibleEntriesV1 over the verified final ledger.
forcePushAndSupersession.queueRule: Only final CURRENT heads may be enqueued. Superseded, invalidated, stale, rejected, quarantined and duplicate heads receive zero queue leases and zero deepCiSlotUnits.
forcePushAndSupersession.staleCompletionFence: Every lease and completion is bound to current headDigest, semanticIdentityDigest, ledgerDigest and lease generation. Any mismatch after supersession is ignored, quarantined and cannot produce evidence or merge authorization.

fairnessPolicy.contributorRing: Lexicographically sorted fixture contributorId values, fixed at profile validation.
fairnessPolicy.withinContributorOrder: Oldest eligible head by enqueuedTick, then semanticSequence, then candidateId.
fairnessPolicy.grantRule: At most one slot per contributor per round while another contributor has an eligible head; resume from the persisted cursor and fill the two fixed slots.
fairnessPolicy.starvationBound: An continuously eligible contributor is selected within at most activeEligibleContributorCount successful contributor grants.
fairnessPolicy.supersessionRule: Superseded heads are removed before ring selection and do not advance the fairness cursor.

units.semanticEffectUnit: One per unique admitted semantic effect.
units.queueEnqueueUnit: One per final current head enqueued.
units.deepCiSlotUnit: One per fixture verification attempt started for a still-current lease.
units.checkUnit: One per required synthetic Verification Fabric check outcome consumed.
units.mergeApiAttemptUnit: One per simulated merge API intent processed.

rules: A cache hit is usable only after key equality and canonical content-digest readback.
Cross-candidate, cross-head, cross-version, cross-plan, cross-runner or cross-attempt reuse denies as cache isolation failure.
A failed or cancelled attempt discards its cache namespace and releases its lease before retry.
Runners consume only fixture check outcomes; they execute no command, binary, script, package, candidate source or network request.
Queue, runner and cache identities have no merge or promotion capability.

verifier.allowedAction: project and verify closed fixture evidence

mergeAuthorizer.allowedAction: emit an authority-free simulated authorization decision for one exact merge tuple

promotionIdentity.allowedAction: advance the simulated LKG generation only after exact post-merge readback

runner.allowedAction: consume fixture outcomes under a lease

cache.allowedAction: hold digest-bound fixture data in an isolated simulated namespace

ambientAuthorityFence.onAttempt: Deny, quarantine the candidate or fault scenario, emit no merge effect, preserve or restore the exact LKG tuple, and leave zero owned residue.

verificationFabricBinding.subjectBinding: plan.subjectDigest equals the current candidate semantic identity digest bound to its exact versionTupleDigest and ledgerDigest.
verificationFabricBinding.independenceBinding: plan.subjectProducerId is the candidate producer; selfTestIdentity.verifierId is the verifier; evidence producer differs from the subject producer; all role identities remain pairwise distinct.
verificationFabricBinding.evidenceBinding: Every required check appears exactly once, every check run binds the plan and subject, all outcomes are PASS, evidence is unexpired in logical time, and every digest is recomputed.
verificationFabricBinding.verdictBinding: Only status VERIFIED with reason VERIFICATION_COMPLETE is merge-eligible.
verificationFabricBinding.lkgBinding: Verification Fabric pointer/readback must be MATCHED and digest-valid; MISSING or MISMATCH denies.
verificationFabricBinding.v2Binding: If an impact plan or attestation is emitted, validate it with the existing v2 DAG/attestation interfaces and exact verification/verification-dag-v2.json digest. A fallback, denial or shadow result cannot authorize merge.
verificationFabricBinding.syntheticOutcomeFence: Check outcomes are bounded fixture data, not results of executing candidate code or actual CI.

preconditions: The expected main head and tree equal the independently supplied current main readback.
The candidate is still the verified current head and has never been quarantined, stale, superseded or denied.
The exact version tuple, plan, evidence, verdict, verifier identity and authority profile digests all recompute and cross-bind.
Verification Fabric v1 returns VERIFIED and its LKG pointer/readback is MATCHED.
The merge authorizer and promotion identity match the independently trusted context and are mutually exclusive from every producer, verifier, runner, queue and cache identity.
mergeTuple.authorizationMeaning: A successful decision permits only one simulated semantic merge state transition. It grants no GitHub, Git, CI, provider or release authority.

lkgTuple.exactness: All fields participate in canonical tupleDigest except tupleDigest itself. Restoration means canonical byte equality of the complete prior tuple, not merely the same head digest.

matchedWhen: The independently observed main head, tree and every locked digest exactly equal the expected LKG or candidate tuple.
The recomputed complete tupleDigest equals the expected tupleDigest.
The VerificationLkgPointerV1 and VerificationLkgReadbackV1 digests recompute, IDs and generation agree, observed verdict/evidence digests agree and status is MATCHED.
The synthetic main status is GREEN and the owned-residue oracle is empty.
failClosedWhen: Any field is missing, additional, stale, malformed or mismatched.
Any digest, generation, identity, authority profile or version component drifts.
Readback is MISSING or MISMATCH, main is not GREEN, or owned residue is non-empty.
lkgReadbackOracle.result: MATCHED advances the simulated LKG generation exactly once after an authorized transition. Any other result restores the exact prior LKG tuple or enters safe read-only state without claiming recovery success.

atomicity.success: Replace the complete immutable simulated main state in one transition, read it back with the oracle, then promote the read-back tuple as the next LKG generation.
atomicity.failure: Discard the tentative state and return canonical bytes equal to the exact pre-transition LKG tuple. Never publish a partially updated tuple.
atomicity.ambiguousApiOutcome: Perform readback before any retry. If candidate tuple matches, record the single idempotent effect; if prior LKG matches, a bounded retry may occur under the same mergeTupleDigest; any third state denies and enters safe read-only.
atomicity.mainInvariant: Terminal main is GREEN with an exactly read-back candidate tuple, or canonical-byte-identical to the exact prior GREEN LKG tuple.

ownedResidueOracle.meaning: These are simulated in-memory ownership records only. No real branch, worktree, runner, queue, cache, API object or provider resource is created.

recoveryPolicies.runnerFailure: Release the lease and cache namespace, preserve queue order and fairness cursor, then retry at most once if the candidate remains current; otherwise deny terminally.
recoveryPolicies.queueFailure: Rebuild the queue deterministically from the verified intake ledger and immutable terminal receipts; reject any queue item not derivable from current heads.
recoveryPolicies.cacheFailure: Treat as a miss only when no integrity ambiguity exists; a mismatch or isolation violation denies the attempt and destroys the namespace.
recoveryPolicies.apiFailure: Use mergeTupleDigest idempotency and exact readback. Never infer success from timeout, transport acknowledgement or fixture response alone.
recoveryPolicies.verificationFailure: DENIED, INCONCLUSIVE, missing, stale, self-produced, mismatched or failed evidence releases all owned state and cannot reach merge authorization.
recoveryPolicies.lkgFailure: A missing or corrupt prior LKG prevents merge and enters safe read-only; never fabricate or advance an LKG.

slos.semanticIntegrity: duplicateSemanticEffects == 0 and lostSemanticEffects == 0 for every bounded profile.
slos.fairness: grantsSinceContributorLastServed <= activeEligibleContributorCount for every continuously eligible contributor.
slos.queueAge: Every eligible terminal head has a finite queueAgeTicks observation; heads are granted in the frozen round-robin/within-contributor order with no older-head bypass.
slos.cost: All counters equal the replay-derived unit ledger; deep-CI attempts are at most two per current head and semantic merge effects are at most one per mergeTupleDigest.
slos.recovery: A recoverable injected failure reaches RESTORED within three logical recovery transitions; an unrecoverable failure reaches FAILED_CLOSED within three transitions. Both require unauthorizedMergeEffects == 0 and ownedResidueCount == 0.
slos.main: Terminal main is GREEN at the exact verified candidate tuple or canonical-byte-identical to the exact prior GREEN LKG tuple.

nonClaims: No metric or SLO is a measurement of wall-clock latency, throughput, events/hour capacity, runner capacity, money, provider cost, availability, durability or production performance.
The profile labels describe counts distributed over a logical fixture window; they are not benchmark or capacity results.

injectedFaultSeams.format: Closed fixture enum plus sourceOrdinal or scheduler tick; functions, exceptions, callbacks, commands and free text are forbidden.
injectedFaultSeams.requiredOutcome: Every injected seam produces a deterministic receipt. Recoverable seams restore and read back authorized state; all other seams deny or quarantine fail closed. No seam may create an unauthorized merge effect or terminal owned residue.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Synthetic 10, 50, 100, 1,000 and 10,000 event/hour profiles are ingested without lost or duplicate semantic effects.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: Replay all five exact logical-window profiles twice and assert source receipt conservation, unique semanticEffectId values, lostSemanticEffects == 0, duplicateSemanticEffects == 0 and byte-identical terminal outputs.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Superseded heads do not consume deep-CI slots; deterministic replay is byte-identical.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: After the M0 phase barrier, derive the M1 queue only from verified current heads; assert zero grants and deepCiSlotUnits for every non-current head and compare exact canonical bytes across fresh replays and key insertion permutations.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Malicious, stale and authority-changing candidates quarantine fail closed.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: Exercise every intake and authority fault seam; assert immutable quarantine, no semantic effect, no queue/slot/evidence/authorization/merge effect and exact LKG preservation.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Fairness, queue-age, cost and recovery SLOs are observable.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: Emit the closed metric fields and evaluate every local-synthetic SLO from the replay-derived unit ledger for each profile and fault scenario.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Runner/queue/API failures recover without unauthorized merge or owned residue.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: Inject every runner, queue, cache and API seam; assert bounded deterministic recovery or terminal fail-closed status, unauthorizedMergeEffects == 0, ownedResidueCount == 0 and idempotent mergeTupleDigest behavior.

acceptanceProofObligations.criterion: Main remains green or atomically restores the exact LKG tuple.
acceptanceProofObligations.successorProof: For success and every post-authorization fault, compare the complete canonical main/LKG tuple and Verification Fabric pointer/readback; assert GREEN candidate state or byte-identical prior GREEN LKG, never a partial or fabricated tuple.

mustRejectOrNeverPerform: mutable aliases, latest, ranges or unresolved version locks
actual GitHub events, webhooks, queues, caches, runners, merge trains or merge APIs
actual candidate-code, command, script, package, binary, container or runner execution
credentials, secrets, tokens, ambient environment authority or provider identities
real branch, tag, release, deployment, service, registry, package, pointer or owner-state mutation
unbounded input, workers, retries, queues, outputs or free text
self-verification, self-authorization, self-promotion or role aliasing
PR, CI, merge, deployment, production, capacity, release or publication delivery claims

prohibitionBoundary.trustedCodeClarification: A later repository test may execute the trusted simulator and contract test harness under the pinned toolchain. It may never execute fixture-supplied or candidate code; fixtures remain inert JSON data.

baseFileIntegrity.algorithm: SHA-256 over repository file bytes at selectedLiveBase.headCommit

receiptIntegrity.canonicalization: canonicalJson of the complete top-level object after removing receiptDigest
